title: Micro-handoff Hint Orchestrator for Arch/Seqlen-aware Kernel Routing
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: We observe periodic latency spikes and cost regressions for mixed workload traffic (short chat bursts + long-doc prefill) when the runtime switches kernels mid-request. Current autotuners choose kernels primarily on static seqlen buckets or offline microbenchmarks which miss transient phase behavior (prefill -> decode transition). Proposal: Implement a lightweight micro-handoff hint orchestrator that computes a small per-request signature during prefill (token-phase histogram + kv hit rate estimate + hardware occupancy probe) and uses it to route to a warm kernel variant at decode handoff or to trigger a low-overhead microprobe to validate the chosen kernel. This aims to reduce regressive handoffs, shorten tail latency, and avoid expensive microbench floods.
acceptance_criteria: Design doc approved by runtime and performance leads (linked).
Implementation of hint encoder and handoff API in runtime with <200ns median added latency on prefill path.
Canary on dedicated pool: no more than 5% increase in p50 and p95 latency and 10% reduction in handoff-triggered re-profiles across mixed workloads.
Automated telemetry: new signal (handoff_signature, selected_kernel, fallback_reason) emitted for 100% of prefill->decode transitions.
Bench harness reproduces at least two real-world failure modes (prefill-long-short-burst and truncated-prefill) and shows improved cumulative cost per request.
Rollout plan documented with rollback guardrails and quota for microprobes.
tasks: Write design proposal: hint representation, size budget (<=64B), safety/fallback rules, and API surface (runtime + scheduler).
Add lightweight feature extractor in prefill path: token-phase histogram + kv prefix match estimate + occupancy probe (HW counters).
Implement handshake API: attach hint to request metadata and accept hint in decode RPC to consult kernel-recommender.
Extend kernel recommender service to accept hint and return prioritized kernel variants with confidence scores.
Implement microprobe path: isolated short-run probe with budgeted quota and exponential backoff.
Instrument telemetry: new metrics, tags, and dashboards (Grafana + BigQuery).
Create benchmark scenarios (short-chat, long-prefill, mixed bursts) and synthetic A/B load runner.
Canary rollout to 5% of traffic on runtime-staging -> dedicated pool. Monitor and iterate.
comments: 2025-02-12 Aisha Patel: Initial ticket created after SIG-perf discussion. Noted repeated re-profiles on customer A workloads and requests for lower tail latency.
2025-02-14 Marco Hernandez: Spike analysis uploaded to Drive (https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/perf/ENG-137246-analysis). Suggest keeping hint size tiny to avoid p99 regressions on prefill.

2025-02-20 Design review: Decided to use a compact 48-byte binary hint (token-phase 16B, kv-hit-est 8B, occupancy 8B, checksum 8B, reserved 8B). Action: Aisha to update design doc with encoding and backwards compatibility semantics.

2025-02-24 Engineering sync: Implemented extractor prototype in branch feature/eng/ENG-137246-hint; microprobe simulation shows 7% fewer re-profiles but a 150ns median prefill overhead (needs optimization).
2025-02-26 Performance review: Marco requested latency budget reduction to <=200ns and added fallback when hint cannot be parsed. Also added requirement for privacy-safe hints (no user PII).
2025-02-28 QA: Bench harness runs passed for short-chat and mixed-burst scenarios. Observed 12% drop in re-profiles and 4% improvement in p95 for decode-heavy workloads under controlled tests.
2025-03-01 PM review (Ravi Singh): Recommend canary target 2% initially, with telemetry gates before scaling to 20%.
2025-03-01 Note: Blocker - hardware occupancy counters API differs across cloud providers. Infrastructure team assigned to standardize an abstraction (see dependency ENG-142000).
decision_log: Choice of hint size capped at 64B to limit prefill overhead (decision made 2025-02-20).
Fallback strategy: if hint signature checksum fails or parse errors occur, resume current kernel recommender behavior (2025-02-26).
Microprobe budget: start with 0.5% of decode transitions, exponential backoff on failures (2025-02-26).
Telemetry gating: require stable p95 for 24h on canary at 2% traffic before increasing allocation (2025-03-01).
